format: html

```{python}
import polars as pl
from lets_plot import *
import requests
import io
import polars.selectors as cs

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)

# pull json data from https://github.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/raw/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json
response = requests.get("https://github.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/raw/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json")
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))

```

```{python}
# Use cleaned data from Task 3 (I used AI to summerize it to save time copying and pasting)
# Minimal cleaning: normalize obvious errors, set impossible values to null
nullified_df = df.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col("airport_name").str.len_chars() >= 4)
    .then(pl.col("airport_name"))
    .otherwise(None)
    .alias("airport_name"),

    pl.when(pl.col("month").is_in([
        "January","February","Febuary","March","April","May","June",
        "July","August","September","October","November","December"
    ]))
    .then(pl.col("month"))
    .otherwise(None)
    .alias("month"),

    pl.when(pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier") == "1500+")
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier"))
    .alias("num_of_delays_carrier"),
).with_columns(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Int64)
)

int_cols = nullified_df.select(cs.by_dtype(pl.Int64)).columns
nullified_df = nullified_df.with_columns(
    [pl.when(pl.col(c) < 0).then(None).otherwise(pl.col(c)).alias(c) for c in int_cols]
)

cleaned_df = nullified_df.with_columns(
    cs.starts_with("num_of_").fill_null(cs.starts_with("num_of_").mean()),
    cs.starts_with("minutes_").fill_null(cs.starts_with("minutes_").median())
)
```


```{python}
display(cleaned_df)
```
